channel.title: Paksh: Environment
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Fire Destroys Zanzibar Beachfront Hotels, Tourists Evacuated
item.description: A fire swept through beachfront hotels in Zanzibar, forcing tourists to evacuate. The blaze destroyed six hotels in the popular Nungwi Beach area. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Otters Return to Kuala Lumpur River, Signaling Environmental Improvement
item.description: The return of otters to the Klang River in Kuala Lumpur is being seen as a positive sign for the river's environmental revival. This wildlife, previously absent due to pollution, has reappeared, sparking hope for the ongoing efforts to… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Report Blames Israel for Widespread Toxic Pollution in Gaza
item.description: A report indicates that contamination in Gaza will endanger lives for generations, with 99% of the area affected by toxic pollution. Israel has been blamed for these environmental crimes. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Kathryn Bowen's Article on Climate Change and Health Published
item.description: An article by Kathryn Bowen, published via The Conversation and featured on Scroll.in and The Quint, discusses the intersection of climate change and public health. The piece, authored by Bowen, explores the health implications of a… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: El Niño Storms Test California Coastline
item.description: California is bracing for a critical test as El Niño is expected to bring high tides and significant storms to its coast in the coming week. The intensity of these weather events will be a key indicator of the coastline's resilience. Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Bird Flu Outbreak Confirmed in France, European Cases Rise
item.description: France has confirmed a deadly bird flu outbreak on a poultry farm, leading to a 'high' alert level being implemented last Friday. The outbreak follows a poultry show, and European cases of bird flu are reportedly rising. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Odisha CM Visits Flood-Hit Ganjam, Reviews Restoration Efforts
item.description: Odisha Chief Minister Majhi visited the flood-affected Ganjam district to inspect damaged paddy fields. The Principal Secretary of the Water Resources department also reviewed restoration works in the district. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Weather forecasts for November 18, 2026
item.description: Weather forecasts for November 18, 2026, were issued by multiple outlets. Amar Ujala provided a forecast for India, while CTV News offered a forecast for Lethbridge, Canada. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Explosion at Iraqi Power Station Kills Four
item.description: An explosion at a power station in Iraq resulted in the deaths of at least four people. The incident occurred at a power station in Iraq. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Thailand Plans Chemical Export Ban to Combat Pollution
item.description: Thailand is planning to ban the export of certain chemicals as part of its efforts to address pollution issues. The specific chemicals targeted and the timeline for the ban were not detailed in the provided coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: South Florida Flooded by Heavy Rainfall
item.description: Heavy rainfall, described as supercharged by El Niño, caused devastating flooding in South Florida, leading to school closures and forced evacuations. Images and videos documented the extent of the flooding across roads and other areas. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Florida experienced significant rainfall and storms attributed to El Niño, resulting in widespread hail and high water. Reports included damage from a tornado, large hail, and high winds within a 24-hour period. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The High Court of Karnataka has ordered the State government to conduct a comprehensive, scientific, and statewide survey to identify all forests and forest-like areas that have not been officially notified, recognized, classified, or… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Maharashtra government is preparing to provide relief to 1.5 crore farmers affected by drought conditions. The administration has declared two additional talukas as drought-hit, bringing the total to 310. Authorities are also planning… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Egg Producer Culls Millions of Birds Due to Bird Flu
item.description: Cal-Maine Foods, the largest U.S. egg producer, announced it will cull approximately 1.76 million birds from its facility in Florida after it tested positive for bird flu. The outbreak affects a significant portion of the company's flock. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has begun felling 184 trees at Nana Nani Park in Mumbai to facilitate the Coastal Road project. This action has led to a dispute, with residents lodging over 3,200 objections. The felling… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Atomic safety regulators have indicated that the risk of a nuclear accident in Ukraine is increasing this winter. Experts have expressed concerns about the potential for such an event. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Intensifies Action Against Pollution Violators
item.description: Authorities in Delhi are increasing enforcement against pollution, with stricter measures planned for issues ranging from dust to smoke. In the past week, traffic police issued 3,048 challans for violations of pollution regulations. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: BMC partners with Dutch NGO on plastic waste prevention
item.description: The Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with a Dutch non-governmental organization (NGO) to prevent plastic waste from entering the ocean. The agreement aims to address plastic pollution. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: Cyclone Akvan is intensifying in the Bay of Bengal and is projected to make landfall on India's east coast, specifically between Nellore and Visakhapatnam in Andhra Pradesh, on November 20. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 6 · Right 7.

item.title: Millions of Red Crabs Begin Annual Migration on Christmas Island
item.description: Millions of red crabs have commenced their annual migration from forests to the sea on Christmas Island, an Australian territory, to breed. The event marks a significant natural spectacle as the crabs traverse the island's landscape. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: A snow warning has been issued for a significant portion of the country, with potential for rush hour disruption. The warning is in effect for a large part of the country. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sea turtles hatch on California beach after rare nesting
item.description: Olive ridley sea turtles hatched on a California beach, marking a rare event where the species has nested and reproduced. The hatchlings were released back into the ocean in Orange County. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.description: A magnitude 6 earthquake has struck Papua New Guinea. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Elephant carcass found in forest, cause of death unknown
item.description: The carcass of a tusker elephant was discovered in the forests of Barkagaon. A herd of elephants is present in the vicinity. Forest officials are investigating the cause of the elephant's death. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.description: Global leaders have been told to increase their efforts to combat climate change, as a significant target has not been met. The call for more ambitious action comes amid discussions about financial commitments, targets, and the overall… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: London Fog Causes Flight Cancellations and Air Pollution Alert
item.description: Thick fog has led to flight cancellations at Heathrow and London City Airport. A high air pollution alert has also been issued for London due to the weather conditions, which are threatening travel disruption. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Severe Storm Hits South-East Queensland
item.description: A severe supercell storm, accompanied by a 'phenomenal' downpour, has caused havoc in south-east Queensland. The intense storm smashed the region. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.description: World leaders have begun discussions at a UN climate conference, with scientists warning that global warming is likely to surpass 1.5 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels. Concerns have been raised about the adequacy and pace of… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.description: Climate activist Greta Thunberg has criticized the UN's Conference of the Parties (COP) climate summits, referring to them as 'greenwashed circuses' and 'hypocrisy'. She made these remarks during COP31, stating that 'everything we love is… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Diwali Firecrackers Caused Over 70% of Delhi's PM2.5 Pollution
item.description: On Diwali, firecrackers were responsible for more than 70% of the major air pollutant PM2.5 in Delhi. This data indicates a significant contribution of firecracker emissions to the city's air quality during the festival. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.description: A Western Disturbance is expected to bring rain and snowfall to the Western Himalayas until November 13. Heavy rainfall is possible in Kashmir on November 12. Concurrently, a low-pressure area forming in the Bay of Bengal by November 13… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.
